title: Jain release authority projection
description: Closed, root-brokered v10 candidate metadata projected from the authenticated control-plane manifest. source_manifest_sha256 commits to that manifest in full, including the member release bindings it currently records; the projection alone asserts neither binding completeness nor release readiness.

source_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete authenticated control-plane manifest, including all current member release bindings. It fixes which manifest was projected; it does not claim every member is bound.
